subject: computer-science
title: Digital Wellbeing: Personal Data
welcome_lead: Your data is valuable — let's keep it safe.
meta_desc: KS3 e-safety: personal data, oversharing, scams, passwords.
final_note: If something feels off, it usually is.

concepts.def: Info that can identify you, like your name.
Posting more than is safe to share.
A trick to get money or data.
Secret you use to prove who you are.
You agree before data is collected.

walkthroughs.body_html: Name, address, school, birthday and photos are personal data. Combined, they can be used to impersonate you. Share with care.
Scams create urgency. 'Click NOW or lose access.' Pause, check, ask an adult. Never share a code from a text.
Use long, unique passwords and turn on two-factor where you can. Even if a site leaks data, your accounts stay safe.
